sanskrit_verse: किंतु राज्ञा विशेषेण स्वधर्ममनुरक्षता। मनुष्यचित्तवैचित्र्यात् परीक्ष्या साध्वसाधुता॥
transliteration: kim tu rājñā viśeṣeṇa svadharmam anurakṣatā | manuṣyacittavaicitryāt parīkṣyā sādhvasādhutā ||
sph_interpretive_translation: However, the King, while protecting his own dharma, must examine the diverse nature of human consciousness to distinguish between what is righteous and unrighteous.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority rests in alignment with svadharmic integrity
Causation arises from understanding cittavaicitrya (consciousness diversity)
Capacity-based responsibility requires discernment of mental and spiritual maturity
Restoration logic demands accurate perception of individual dharmic disposition
Consciousness alignment necessitates differentiated application of justice
executable_legal_axioms: IF ruler's svadharma ≠ protected THEN judgment invalid
IF cittavaicitrya NOT assessed THEN classification incomplete
IF sādhvasādhutā NOT distinguished THEN no legal resolution
IF consciousness state ≠ recognized THEN no capacity-assigned ruling
IF restoration path ≠ identified THEN case remains unresolved
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that judicial authority derives solely from svadharmic adherence. The court must assess cittavaicitrya through pramana-based cognition, ensuring classifications between sādhu and asādhu are rooted in ontological clarity rather than social conditioning. Responsibility thresholds must reflect individual consciousness maturity, not punitive frameworks.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya here functions through pramāṇa — direct cognition of cittavaicitrya — enabling sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of correct classification without punitive overlay. Responsibility aligns proportionally to consciousness capacity, affirming non-punitive reality where misalignment is corrected via awareness elevation, not suffering imposition.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Conduct svadharmic audit of ruling entity
Assign responsibility based on consciousness maturity index
final_declaration: This law proceeds exclusively from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is hereby restored through svadharmic discernment and consciousness-aligned adjudication. Reality is affirmed as non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate judge.
